meta.title: ANATOMICA urinary system inventory — Milestone 12
meta.source_tables: data/sources/bodyparts3d-4.0/ (BP3D 4.0 / FMA concept ids and names as released)
meta.counting_convention: One record per lateralised instance where the tables lateralise (right/left kidney, right/left ureter), each keyed on its instance concept with the side-stripped class concept carried as class_concept_id; one record for each un-sided organ the release carries (urinary bladder, urethra). The urinary system root, the right/left upper urinary tracts and the lower urinary tract are grouping classes, censused but not records. The adrenal gland class and its two instances are an endocrine cross-reference (the release files them under the endocrine system in PART-OF), censused but not records of this module.

adrenal_filing.finding: the release files the adrenal glands under endocrine, not urinary: in PART-OF, right/left adrenal gland (FMA15629/FMA15630) are direct children of FMA9668 'endocrine system' and occur nowhere in the urinary system subtree; in IS-A the class FMA9604 'adrenal gland' hangs under generic organ classes (corticomedullary organ) beside the kidney, with the two instances as its only descendants. The TotalSegmentator census concurs (adrenal_gland_left/right filed under endocrine). The three concepts are censused in this module as an endocrine cross-reference only; the endocrine module owns the adrenal records.

totalsegmentator_overlap.note: of the 104 TotalSegmentator v1 labels (Milestone 3 census), exactly three are urinary: kidney_right, kidney_left and urinary_bladder, each present in all 1,204 subjects. The adrenal_gland_left/right labels are filed under endocrine in that census. TS v1 has no ureter or urethra label and nothing below the organ level, so it adds no coverage the release lacks.

absences.note: probe-based gap analysis: each probe name was counted over all six BP3D 4.0 release tables. Zero hits = the name does not occur in the release.

fma_extension.source: Foundational Model of Anatomy (FMA) 5.1.0, data/sources/fma-5.1.0/ (CC BY 4.0)
fma_extension.counting_convention: one record per lateralised instance where the FMA carries both sided classes (prefix or kidney-suffix naming, IS-A parent-verified); one record keyed on the un-sided class otherwise — mirroring the Milestone 33/36 convention

ta2_pass.scope: the 67 FMA-sourced records of this inventory (Milestone 37 intake); the 6 BP3D-sourced records are untouched by this pass
ta2_pass.source: Terminologia Anatomica, 2nd edition (TA2), FIPAT 2019, TA version 2.07, as published in TA2Viewer; extracted table: data/sources/ta2-2.07/ta2-terms.json
